svg.title: Follow the observation all the way to the review decision.

cc:Work.dc:title: Follow the observation all the way to the review decision.
cc:Work.dc:description: Synthetic fixture · 480 accepted readings · 4 quarantined · 503 signed events No real bioreactor or cleanroom data. Accepted means the input contract passed, not that the process is in control. Particle accounting combines two disjoint size bins over 30 simulated minutes; no viable-organism or resolved-airflow inference is made.
